mutations.label: run-tests: the files start in the order given, not sorted as node --test sorts them
mutations.from: const stream = run({ files, concurrency, isolation: 'process' })
mutations.to: const stream = run({ files: [...files].sort(), concurrency, isolation: 'process' })
mutations.only: ^(?:the runner starts the files in the order it is given them)$

mutations.label: run-tests: it exits 0 only on a summary that says success
mutations.only: ^(?:a run with no summary did not pass)$

mutations.label: run-tests: the per-file times are written where it is told to
